locator.section: In Litaniis maioribus et minoribus, Missa de Rogationibus, Oratio

entries.claim: The Mass of the Rogations prints this Collect's 20-word body in full with the abbreviated conclusion cue Per Dóminum. Its letters and accents equal page 511 and the selected body. It has a comma after ut (ut, qui), where page 511 and the selected text have ut qui.

This proper page prints the 20-word Collect body (w001–w020) and the abbreviated Per Dominum cue. The full w021–w042 conclusion and Amen are not printed in full on this proper page; the same-edition RG115a dependency supplies them. Headings and adjoining rubrics are excluded. This is a narrow textual source claim, not complete commemoration/calendar or actor approval.

locator.section: Rubricae generales115a, full Father-directed conclusion; neighbouring115b–e excluded

entries.claim: RG115a prescribes the 21-word Father-directed conclusion and Amen (w021–w042). This formula is supplied after the proper body’s abbreviated cue, not printed continuously on the proper page. The unaccented rubric prints no comma after Christum and ends with the rubric enumeration punctuation “Amen;”. Its literal accidentals differ from the selected accented reader setting. The rule does not assign a response actor; two loci of one edition are not two independent witnesses.
